tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Architectural Documentation
tasks.description:
Perform a deep architectural analysis of the mini calculator project and create a detailed architectural.md file in the project root.

Analysis Requirements:
1. Read and analyze all source files:
   - src/App.tsx (main application entry)
   - src/components/Calculator.tsx (core calculator logic and state)
   - src/components/Display.tsx (display component)
   - src/components/Button.tsx (button component)
   - src/App.css, src/components/*.css (styling and theming)
   - vite.config.ts (build configuration)
   - tsconfig.json (TypeScript configuration)
   - package.json (dependencies and tooling)

2. Document the following in architectural.md:
   - Project Overview: Purpose, tech stack, key features
   - Architecture Overview: High-level design patterns and principles
   - Component Architecture: Component hierarchy, data flow, and relationships
   - State Management: How state is managed and flows through the application
   - Styling Architecture: CSS approach, theming system (dark/light mode), design tokens
   - Testing Strategy: Test framework setup, testing patterns, coverage approach
   - Build & Development: Vite configuration, TypeScript setup, development workflow
   - Code Organization: Directory structure, file naming conventions, module organization
   - Technical Decisions: Key architectural choices and their rationale
   - Future Considerations: Potential improvements or technical debt

3. Use clear sections, subsections, and code examples where appropriate
4. Include ASCII diagrams for component hierarchy and data flow if helpful
5. Make the documentation comprehensive yet readable for new developers joining the project
acceptance_criteria: architectural.md file created in project root directory
All major architectural aspects documented with clear explanations
Component relationships and data flow clearly described
Documentation is well-structured with clear sections and examples
